LESSON: OBSERVING AND ARTICULATING SIGNS (LISTENING AND SPEAKING) 6.1.1 AUDITORY MEMORY AND VISUAL MEMORY

Subject: General
Strand: MY SCHOOL Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested Learning Experi
Topic 6.1: Observing and Articulating signs (listening and speaking) 6.1.1 Auditory memory and visual memory
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Observing and Articulating signs (listening and speaking) 6.1.1 Auditory memory and visual memory, part of MY SCHOOL Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested Learning Experi in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: Which sounds do we hear in the school environment? 2. Which sounds did you hear in the morning?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Observing and Articulating signs (listening and speaking) 6.1.1 Auditory memory and visual memory together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
• Respect: Patience as learner works well with others in harmony and gives each time to say sounds recalled.

• Unity: Cooperation as learner interacts with others positively in groups without disagreeing.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
• Health related issues awareness as learner learns that very loud sound in the environment could lead to hearing issues.

Link to other Learning Areas:

All learning areas as the learners need to recall what they have learnt .

Suggested Learning Resources:

assistive devices fitted with appropriate technology such as hearing aids and amplifiers, pictures, real things in the environment such

as bells, vehicles, animals, motorbike
